body: The sun beat down on the wooden bridge beneath my feet, steam rising from the wet planks. A faint scent of ozone mingled with the musty smell of old wood. I shifted uneasily on my heels, fingers brushing against the cold metal bars supporting the walkway. My pulse thumped loudly in my ears as I tried to ignore the feeling of warmth spreading through me. "Let's go," I muttered, looking at the distant signpost pointing towards the village.
